title: codariocalyx microphyllus var. macrocarpus
intro: Codariocalyx microphyllus var. macrocarpus, commonly known as Himalayan Cat's Whisker, is a plant species belonging to the family Convolvulaceae. The plant has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions, with its health benefits including antispasmodic, anti-inflammatory, and antiviral properties. Its therapeutic actions include relieving muscle spasms, reducing fever, and soothing digestive issues. The bioactive constituents of Codariocalyx microphyllus var. macrocarpus include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
